interpretation.timing_limit: Identity receipts have no started timestamps; mtimes attribute finish-to-finish intervals including host/transport/scheduler time, not isolated CPU or command duration. Startup and first-read duration are omitted. Before-unlock for current window not yet measured.

interpretation.epoch_policy: Keep all pre-lock, after-lock and before-unlock observations. Never reuse a previous phase or previous window result.
